title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via Storable::retrieve (perl) — review required
description: In perl, Storable::retrieve performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The perl-specific remedy is data-only decoding via JSON or Sereal with validation.
applicability: perl codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through Storable::retrieve; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
